name: email-protocol
description: Search email accounts from Codex through provider-supported POP3 or IMAP.

interface.shortDescription: Search mailboxes through POP3 or IMAP.
interface.longDescription: Email Protocol helps Codex search and inspect email accounts when the provider supports POP3 or IMAP. It is read-only by default and does not include SMTP sending. Provider-specific setup notes live in manuals, starting with Naver Mail.
defaultPrompt: Search my email receipts this month.
Find payment emails in a POP mailbox.
Search an IMAP mailbox for purchase history.
